Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Hello y'all,

backintown after a few computer problems, so I've got a few Qs :

- Anesthetic Touch : can you play a S:CE against it even though it ends
combat as a first strike ? Will the after effects (untap for Majesty, of
inflict one damage, or burn one blood) of the CE still resolve ? I think
normally only the effects of the first S:CE (the one from the acting minion)
resolves, right ? So what happens there ?

- Spirit Marionette : can you use a Master Card in play after the borrowed
minion made his action (say, a bleed) but before giving him back ? I'm
thinking Heidelberg, or burn with Antediluvian Awakening, here... And
speaking of which, can you burn the minion at just any moment ?

Hum, must be all for now, I'll be back if I remember more questions...

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
|| Hello y'all,
||
|| backintown after a few computer problems, so I've got a few Qs :

Glad you're back. Lsj is on holidays, i am his sexy secretary and can help
you =)

|| - Anesthetic Touch : can you play a S:CE against it even though it
|| ends combat as a first strike ? Will the after effects (untap for
|| Majesty, of inflict one damage, or burn one blood) of the CE still
|| resolve ?

Anesthetic touch is a *hand strike*. After that hand strike is resolved,
combat ends. If you played a dodge or a combat ends yourself; you will avoid
the damage from this hand strike. All the effect of your defensive strike
apply : Earthmeld will untap you, catatonic fear will inflict one damage to
the vampire playing anesthetic touch etc...

|| - Spirit Marionette : can you use a Master Card in play after the
|| borrowed minion made his action (say, a bleed) but before giving
|| him back ? I'm thinking Heidelberg, or burn with Antediluvian
|| Awakening, here... And speaking of which, can you burn the minion
|| at just any moment ?

You can use a master card between the spirit marionette action and the
mandatory bleed action. You can tap heidelberg to give all the blood to
blanche, because she deserves it. You cannot use the heidelberg after the
mandatory bleed since the vampire goes back to his former controller as soon
as the action ends.
Antediluvian awakening's most recetn text says you must burn the vampire
during the untap phase. In case you want to try the trick with Judgment
Camarilla Segregation, it now specifies that the vampire must be burned
during your master phase. Both cards are impossible to combine with Spirit
Marionette.

|| Hum, must be all for now, I'll be back if I remember more
|| questions...

I'll tell him that you called !
have a nice day =)
